rule: Historical partial promises are closed by explicit current-edition inclusion and documented exclusions; v2 mandatory security/test work remains separately gated, never excluded. Status is implementation/scope reconciliation, not a claim that future F7 evidence already passed.

1.edition_scope: Windows, offline Godot4.7 and compact edition; broad hardware/FPS/HDD targets are not certified.

2.edition_scope: Development rules are enforced by guarded commits, resource validation and the v2 gate.

3.edition_scope: First-person combat plus settlement, diplomacy and conquest; diplomatic, military and mixed endings.

4.edition_scope: Connected systems and real transactions; this is the compact edition described below.

5.edition_scope: Explore, fight, brew, manage and resolve the campaign; reward pacing is not a guaranteed timed schedule.

6.edition_scope: Connected4000-unit terrain,14 towns,8 regions,40 POIs, danger/road discovery and paid travel.
6.excluded: Enterable caves/cellars, apiaries/mills as separate playable systems

7.edition_scope: Road network, vegetation clusters, scenery and readable landmarks; road-density review belongs to the art pass.
7.excluded: Complete interior navigation and an everywhere/off-road30-second guarantee

8.edition_scope: Calendar, seasons, five weather states and their supported numeric modifiers; civilian routines.
8.excluded: Animal panic/lightning propagation, persistent snow tracks, extinguishable world fires

9.edition_scope: Eight profiles, bounded relations/threat/escalation,5 treaty types, gifts and alliance/conquest progress.
9.excluded: Independent regional economies, spies, hostages, nine contract types and bespoke red-line negotiations

10.edition_scope: Aggregated jobs, health/happiness, housing, supply, migration and constrained enlistment.
10.excluded: Sex/age demographics, water supply, epidemic transmission and refugee-management simulation

11.edition_scope: Food/wood/ore/stone/gold production, upkeep, resource trading, taxes and workshop bonuses.
11.excluded: Physical robbable caravans, autonomous inter-region supply chains, separate cloth/leather/ammunition stocks

12.edition_scope: Four unit types, selectable squads/orders/three formations, upkeep and blockade/assault/surrender.
12.excluded: Cavalry, command wheel/selection rectangle, full RTS movement and individual ammunition logistics

13.edition_scope: WASD/look/sprint/jump, melee attack/block, stamina, wear, ordinary death penalties and iron death.
13.excluded: Timed parry/dodge invulnerability, player ranged combat and separate physical damage schools

14.edition_scope: Camp melee/ranged opponents, line-of-sight/cover and3 named bosses with actual combat.
14.excluded: Wildlife ecosystem, corpse/door investigation and coordinated animal pack simulation

15.edition_scope: Tiered equipment, one-time campaign kills/exploration, defined loot and meaningful rewards.
15.excluded: Full legendary clue chronicles and dismantling/smelting every unwanted item

16.edition_scope: Inventory list, weight, item comparison, head/torso/legs/weapon equipment, use/drop/repair.
16.excluded: Paper-doll grid/filter system, separate hands/feet/cloak/offhand and four configurable quick slots

17.edition_scope: 25 potion recipes, ingredient checks, immediate atomic brewing and12 forge blueprints.
17.excluded: Timed brewing, potion-quality tiers/skill-based failure, magic/mana/bombs/scrolls

18.edition_scope: Progress through equipment, campaign objectives, recruited companions and regional relationships.
18.excluded: Four character skill trees, player perk unlocks and reputation-title dialogue trees

19.edition_scope: 60 dependency-linked objectives, eight regional chains and four companion recruitments.
19.excluded: Twenty fully authored narrative chains, procedurally branching investigations and NPC-heir quest substitution

20.edition_scope: Four companion actors and nearby profession-based civilian schedules; distant aggregate state.
20.excluded: Individual needs/dialogue/relationship simulation for every villager

21.edition_scope: Compact HUD/F1 help, journal/council/map, comparison inventory, settlement/town/workshop screens.
21.excluded: Minimap, command wheel, full grid inventory and authored ambient breath/heartbeat system

22.edition_scope: RU/EN keyed catalogs, placeholder/glyph audits, persistent live language and first-launch selection.

23.edition_scope: Licensed stylized figures, PBR scenery, Filmic environment, non-volumetric distance fog and restrained UI.
23.excluded: SDFGI/SSR/SSAO/volumetric fog, photoreal scale and ultra-low polygon counts for all licensed models

24.edition_scope: Four unique mood tracks, two finale stingers, spatial effects/material footsteps and real audio buses.
24.excluded: Spoken dialogue, choir guarantee and six fully separate reverberation-zone presets

25.edition_scope: Authenticated/validated/atomic saves and resource boundaries; new data/QA/encryption guarantees are gated in F5.
25.excluded: Unbreakable offline DRM or runtime memory-editor prevention

26.edition_scope: MultiMesh vegetation, distance limits, cached art/resources and measured available-host performance.
26.excluded: Five-hour hardware certification and identical performance across all GPUs

27.edition_scope: Signal-driven autoloads, resource-backed data, modular systems and checked runtime schemas.
27.excluded: Exact historic class/file names when equivalent edition implementations exist

28.edition_scope: 15-step introductory route, four difficulty levels plus independent iron flag; language/audio/camera/MSAA/reduced motion.
28.excluded: Full key rebinding, axis inversion, UI-scale/color-blind presets, shadow/fog/draw-distance sliders

29.edition_scope: Five manual slots, autosave, independent iron slot, backups/migration and finale/exit persistence.
29.excluded: Political-collapse/capital-loss defeat conditions outside permanent iron death

30.edition_scope: Historical stages are superseded by the adopted v2 sequential evidence gate.

31.edition_scope: Automated acceptance is attached to real tests; final v2 evidence is generated after changes.

32.edition_scope: Repository, licensing, no-placeholder and public-history rules remain binding.

33.edition_scope: The current edition and v2 gate determine shipping scope; larger historical checklists are indexed here.
33.excluded: Any unimplemented broader roadmap item above

34.edition_scope: Historical report template is process guidance, not additional playable content.

35.edition_scope: Coherent compact gameplay and legible consequences are the direction, with measured checks.
35.excluded: A universal subjective guarantee of fun or perfection
